title: LiquidSource
description: Mod for highlights water and lava source blocks with customizable colors and transparency
body:
# LiquidSource

A Minecraft (Fabric) client mod that highlights water and lava source blocks.

## Requirements

- **Minecraft**: 26.1 - 26.2
- **Fabric Loader**: 0.19.2 or newer
- **Fabric API**: 0.152.1+26.1.2 or newer
- [**Mod Menu**](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)
- [**Cloth Config API**](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)

## Screenshots

### Water source blocks

![Water source blocks](https://github.com/keeniGithub/LiquidSource/blob/master/image/water.png?raw=true)

### Lava source blocks

![Lava source blocks](https://github.com/keeniGithub/LiquidSource/blob/master/image/lava.png?raw=true)

## Configuration

Install **Mod Menu**, open it from the pause or title screen, find **LiquidSource**, and click the config button.

The color value is entered as an ARGB hex string:

![Color input](https://github.com/keeniGithub/LiquidSource/blob/master/image/color_input.png?raw=true)

- The first **2 characters** are the transparency (alpha channel).
- The remaining **6 characters** are the hex color value.
